title: Valtellina War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Valtellina War", at revision 1370749053, opens: "The Valtellina War (1620–1626) was an episode of the Thirty Years' War arising out of competition to control the Valtelline, an Alpine valley forming a key part of the Spanish Road." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3778677, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war in Northern Italy between pro-Habsburg and anti-Habsburg forces; part of the Thirty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
